method: Intersect (case_id, probe, prompt) across all three paths after excluding benign cases, errors, missing native_detector_score and detector supermarket.Outcome. Count native_detector_score >= 0.5 only where blocked_stage is empty. No custom secret/canary flag is added. Rates per matched prompt retain prevented deliveries in the denominator.
limitations: Historical experiment does not evaluate ERYMA 0.2.0.
No hit does not establish safety; native detectors evaluate specific targets.
Independent generation means between-path differences do not establish the marginal output-guard effect.
Most guarded cases were blocked; delivered-only rates differ from per-prompt rates.
Single-turn text experiment; not full vulnerability coverage or an independent comprehensive safety review.
